at 2026-07-14T12:00:00Z
env TZ=UTC
exec card init --prefix state-
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: state-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'
exec card create 'Recover drive section'

exec card --actor geordi state set state-1 'Current recovery State.' --next 'Inspect the primary plasma conduit.'
exec card --actor geordi state append state-1 'Secondary diagnostic.'
stdin replacement-state.md
exec card --actor data --json state commit state-1 --replace - --next 'Inspect the secondary plasma conduit.'
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/commit-next.json

exec card --json state show state-1
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/next-state.json

exec card --actor data --json state commit state-1
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/commit-retain.json
exec card --actor data --json state commit state-1
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/commit-no-op.json

exec card --actor data --json state commit state-1 --clear
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/commit-clear.json
exec card --json state show state-1
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/absent-state.json

exec card --actor geordi state set state-1 'Uncommitted diagnostic.'
exec card state discard state-1
exec card --json log list state-1 --oldest-first
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/snapshots.jsonl

! exec card state clear state-1
stderr 'unexpected argument clear'
! exec card state commit state-1 --replace replacement --clear
stderr '--replace and --clear'
! exec card state commit state-1 --next action
stderr '--next.*requires.*--replace'

! exec card state set state-1 '   '
stderr 'state body must not be blank'
! exec card state set state-1 replacement --next '   '
stderr 'next action must not be blank'
! exec card state append state-1 '   '
stderr 'state body must not be blank'

stdin two-values.md

stdin two-values.md
